exposure: systematic laparoscopic skills and suture training (SLSST)
cohort: 244 patients who underwent total laparoscopic hysterectomy (TLH) at a Brazilian teaching hospital between 2008 and 2014
finding: The implementation of a systematic laparoscopic skills and suture training program was associated with a significant reduction in operative time and length of hospital stay for patients undergoing total laparoscopic hysterectomy.
